environment.description: IoT message broker deployed behind AWS IoT Core custom authorizer with API Gateway (HTTP API type) integration. The API Gateway route /api/v1/device/message has a throttling configuration applied at the route level: steady-state rate of 1 request per second per source IP with burst capacity of 2. The throttle returns 429 Too Many Requests before the integration backend is invoked. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a default route throttle of 10 rps aggregate. CloudWatch metrics confirm that throttled requests (4xx count from GatewayResponses) never reach the backend Lambda/container. The timing attack requires minimum 10,000 requests per character position (64 hex characters = 640,000+ requests minimum) to achieve statistical significance above network noise. At 1 rps per IP, extraction of a single token would require ~7.4 days of continuous probing per source IP, during which the 30-second time window rotates the valid token 21,000+ times, making any accumulated timing data useless as the target value changes.
